name: Client document request tracker
summary: When a client sends its first batch of records, the engagement manager gets the request list brought up to date: each item and period marked received, incomplete, mentioned only or missing, plus a short follow-up draft. The manager judges what is sufficient and approves anything sent.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of keeping a client's records request up to date: matching each logged file to a requested item and period, counting only what is usable, keeping documents that are merely mentioned apart from documents that have arrived, and drafting a short follow-up for a manager to approve.
